This page uses Veil itself.
The configuration is the `extensions: veil:` block in the front matter of [`examples.qmd`](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-veil/blob/main/docs/examples.qmd).
It declares the groups `advanced` (level 1), `expert` (level 2), and `backup` (independent).
Click the eye button at the bottom left, or press `u`, to open the popover.
Press `]` and `[` to move the ladder setting.

## A ladder

The text below is in three groups.
Each group is hidden by default.

```markdown
::: {.veil group="advanced"}
Advanced: shown at level 1 and above.
:::

::: {.veil group="expert"}
Expert: shown at level 2.
:::
```

::: {.veil group="advanced"}
Advanced: shown at level 1 and above.
:::

::: {.veil group="expert"}
Expert: shown at level 2.
:::

## An independent group

An independent group has no level.
The ladder does not change it.

```markdown
::: {.veil group="backup"}
Backup: shown only when you turn on this group.
:::
```

::: {.veil group="backup"}
Backup: shown only when you turn on this group.
:::

## Inline content

A sentence can hold a [hidden aside]{.veil group="advanced"} in the middle.

```markdown
A sentence can hold a [hidden aside]{.veil group="advanced"} in the middle.
```

## More than one group

An element in more than one group is visible only when all its groups are shown.

::: {.veil group="advanced backup"}
This block needs both `advanced` and `backup`.
:::

## Source

The repository ships a short, standalone starting point you can copy: [`example.qmd`](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-veil/blob/main/example.qmd).
